data.action: 身着黑金旗袍执一盏纸灯，在融融暖光中回眸浅笑
data.description: 【夕 · 岁节灯会】岁节灯火通明的长桥之上，换上一袭玄黑织金改良旗袍的夕手执一盏精巧的兔子纸灯，在融融暖光次回眸浅笑，龙角在灯影下如温润青玉——「人间过节总是吵吵闹闹的……不过偶尔像这样与你并肩提灯走过长街，倒也算得上是一幅上佳的风俗画。」
data.promptProse: Dusk turns back on the festival's long bridge with a faint smile, carrying a small rabbit-shaped paper lantern beside her black-and-gold woven qipao and black heeled shoes. The medium view follows the bridge rail into the distance above the night river. Warm lantern glow illuminates her hand and gold threads, while repeated bridge lights ripple on the water below and darker rail intervals separate the figure from the bright reflections.
data.title: 夕 · 岁节灯会
